mapper.sql: r.id, r.tenant_id, r.name, r.builtin, (SELECT string_agg(p.permission, chr(31) ORDER BY p.permission) FROM app_role_permission p WHERE p.role_id = r.id) AS permissions
mapper.select: SELECT ur.user_id, FROM app_user_role ur JOIN app_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id IN #{id} ORDER BY ur.user_id, r.id
INSERT INTO app_role (tenant_id, name, builtin) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{name}, #{builtin}) RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE app_role SET name = #{name} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM app_role WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND name = #{name})
SELECT ur.role_id, count(*) AS users FROM app_user_role ur JOIN app_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} GROUP BY ur.role_id
SELECT user_id FROM app_user_role WHERE role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY user_id
